figures.caption: Figure S31. FESEM images of CCTO in a 100 μm, b 50 μm and c 20 μm; d EDS mapping of CCTO. High-resolution FESEM analysis reveals that the CCTO particles have a primary particle size of approximately 1 μm, with a significant fraction of nanoparticles present. This nanoscale dimension accounts for the absence of distinct CCTO particles on the macroscopic PLIC surface, as they are uniformly embedded within the polymer matrix. EDS elemental mapping further verifies that the constituent elements of CCTO (Ca, Cu, Ti, and O) are evenly distributed throughout the interlayer, indicating excellent dispersion of CCTO nanoparticles without aggregation. This uniform dispersion is crucial for maximizing the giant dielectric effect and enhancing the mechanical strength of the interlayer[26].
